impact.headline: 9 builds rescheduled. 79 customer deliveries affected at 32 dealers; 18 Platinum/Gold customers got a loaner, 4 entitled customers are waiting (dealer pool empty).
changed: 9 production orders moved (9 same-plant reschedules, 0 transfers); 9 now build later (avg 5.3 days).
32 dealers told about exactly their affected orders (one message each); 18 loaners assigned.
unchanged: 51 of 60 future production orders at P_KY were not affected and were not moved.
57 Standard-tier customers: dealer informed, no loaner (policy rule 5).
4 entitled customers did not get a loaner because the dealer's pool ran out: ['CO-00718', 'CO-00744', 'CO-00763', 'CO-00774']
18 dealers have no affected orders and were not contacted.
No lots held, no vehicles stopped from sale (not part of a delay or outage).
